description: Header file defining internal thread identity structures and functions for Abseil library, including ThreadIdentity and PerThreadSynch classes, thread-local storage management, and thread identity retrieval functions.

classes.name: ThreadIdentity
classes.description: Represents the thread's internal identity, including synchronization state and thread-specific data.

classes.name: PerThreadSynch
classes.description: Handles synchronization primitives and thread wait states within the thread identity.

methods.name: thread_identity()
methods.description: Returns the associated ThreadIdentity for a PerThreadSynch instance.

methods.name: CurrentThreadIdentityIfPresent
methods.description: Returns the current thread's ThreadIdentity if it exists, using thread-local storage.

methods.name: SetCurrentThreadIdentity
methods.description: Associates a ThreadIdentity with the current thread.

methods.name: ClearCurrentThreadIdentity
methods.description: Removes the ThreadIdentity association from the current thread.
